summary: Iteration 313 - Cart Page Redesign with 1mg-inspired dark frosted UI and Stripe International Payment. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend testing confirmed: glassmorphic dark UI, savings ribbon, CuraCoins card with toggle, pharmacy/lab tabs, coupon section (ORANGE15/MANGO10), bill summary with detailed breakdown, delivery options (Priority/Standard), quantity controls, remove item, 'Before you checkout' suggestions, gradient checkout button, and Stripe 'Pay with Card (International)' button that redirects to Stripe checkout.

findings: Dark frosted glassmorphic UI with gradient background
Savings ribbon shows 'You save ₹110 on this order'
Cart toggle tabs: All (3), Medicines (2), Tests (1)
Delivery options: Priority (₹30, 60 min) and Standard (FREE)
Pharmacy items section with medicine cards
Lab items section with test cards
ORANGE15 coupon applied successfully: '15% off medicines - Save ₹63'
'Confirm and pay ₹362' gradient button (orange for pharmacy)
Stripe checkout shows US$1.00 (converted from INR)
3 suggestion tabs: Recommended, Book Tests, Essentials
Upsell banner: 'Add ₹1745 more for extra 2% OFF'
CuraOne Membership banner with 'View Plans' button

Stripe pharmacy checkout correctly converts INR to USD (÷85)
CuraCoins: 100 coins = ₹10 discount, max 500 coins per order
Coupon codes ORANGE15 (15% pharmacy) and MANGO10 (10% lab) work correctly
Auto-coupon tiers: 2% off on ₹2000+, 5% off on ₹3000+
Delivery zones: Primary (free next-day), Secondary (₹49 next-day)
All data-testids present for automated testing
localStorage used for cart persistence (pharmacyCart, labCart, curaCoins)
